fields.v: Inconsistencies: text says in ML & Data 'six of thirteen models resolve no tasks' and 'only the top three exceed 8%' (p. 8), but Table 2 (p. 7) shows 0.0% for three models under OpenHands (Kimi-K2.5, Qwen3.5-397B, Seed-2.0-Pro; six zeros only when both scaffolds are counted) and 8.3% for four further models; Opus-4.7 averages 101 tool calls in §5.2 text and 102 in Figure 6(b); post-QC Terminus scores in Appendix Table 4 (p. 23: Claude-Opus-4.6 30.4% / 0.683, GLM-5.1 20.4% / 0.511, Kimi-K2.5 7.1% / 0.348) differ from Table 2 Terminus rows (31.3% / 0.666, 20.9% / 0.512, 7.8% / 0.360); Appendix G.1 (p. 21) lists the five target languages as Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java, but the benchmark contains C++ (Glaze, thread-pool) and no Java (Table 3, p. 16); §5.4 (p. 10) says GLM-5.1 and Qwen3.6-Plus are 'the only exceptions' doing better on Terminus 2 and that mid/lower-tier models swing 3-10 pp, but Table 2 (p. 7) also shows Kimi-K2.6 (15.7% vs 14.8%) and Qwen3.5-397B (10.4% vs 9.6%) higher on Terminus 2, with swings below 1 pp. Values taken from Table 2. Quality control used agents of three capability tiers and kept only tasks where tiers score differently, which can shape the benchmark towards the models used; Appendix Table 4 suggests these were Claude-Opus-4.6, GLM-5.1 and Kimi-K2.5 under Terminus 2, which are also evaluated models (not stated explicitly). Iterative QC: 45 of 115 tasks needed at least one fix round (average 3.1 rounds). Static review by experts assisted by Claude-Opus-4.7. Repository identities and versions anonymized in instructions. Code (github.com/UniPat-AI/RoadmapBench), dataset (HuggingFace UnipatAI/RoadmapBench) and leaderboard released. No pre-registration. Languages: Python, TypeScript, C++, Go, Rust
fields.quote: Two models perform better on Terminus 2. GLM-5.1 and Qwen3.6-Plus are the only exceptions, with resolved rates 2.6 pp and 4.3 pp higher on Terminus 2.
fields.why: Another reporting inconsistency is missing: Table 2 shows four models (not two) better on Terminus 2, two of them by less than 1 pp, contradicting the §5.4 text.
fields.doubt: O texto (pág. 10) diz que só o GLM-5.1 e o Qwen3.6-Plus são melhores no Terminus 2, mas a Tabela 2 (pág. 7) mostra também o Kimi-K2.6 (15,7 vs 14,8) e o Qwen3.5-397B (10,4 vs 9,6). Confirma na tabela e decide se juntas esta incoerência às Notes.
